# Knot0

> Run AI agents anywhere. Orchestration, execution, and governance for production AI.

## What is Knot0?

Knot0 is an agent orchestration platform for production workloads. It provides execution runtime, governance, and observability for AI agents across any infrastructure.

## Key Capabilities

- Agent orchestration and lifecycle management
- Multi-provider LLM support
- Built-in governance and safety controls
- Real-time observability and monitoring
- Durable execution with suspend/resume
- Event-driven agent communication

## Open Source Tools

- repl-scratchpad: Persistent REPL scratchpad for coding agents — variables survive across turns
- semi-formal-reasoning: Structured code verification, fault localization, and semantic analysis
- vibe-testing: Pressure-test specs with LLM reasoning before writing code
- dagain: DAG-based orchestration CLI for coding agents
